question: Can the orbit-character selection constraint reduce the still-uncosted all-support exact projector sums below the inherited total orbit-term ceiling without a new resource budget?
scientific_boundary: Rank-only structural prerequisite on the fixed ideal L=2 operator orbit and selected full-binary first record. No new second law, private-error information, risk, noisy JIT, L=3, crossing or threshold.

method_basis.local_exact_identity: run_j6n_sequential_local_projector_moments.py: orbit Z expectation is one iff the Z mask has even overlap with every orbit-flip generator; ordered products reduce to signed Z masks. First-subset Z masks therefore form a binary linear signature space, and each attainable second-group signature has an affine preimage of size 2^(n-r).
method_basis.external_context_only: Dehaene and De Moor, The Clifford group, stabilizer states, and linear and quadratic operations over GF(2), Phys. Rev. A 68, 042318 (2003), https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0304125. This motivates binary/quadratic representations, but the project-specific formula is proved by the pinned local exact identity and replay, not assumed from the paper.
method_basis.unresolved_alternative: A group preserving physical action and first public record might identify equivalent supports, but no such automorphism is established; rank signatures alone are not a law-equivalence symmetry. Do not merge supports from matching rank counts.

matrix.supports: Every one of the 54 distinct J8C eight-edge same-first-flux private error supports
matrix.selected_first_public_record: J8C/J8F all-plus charge selection with fixed full-binary first flux; no other first record
matrix.analysis: For each support, calculate the GF(2) rank r of the first-variable-star Z-character signatures against every orbit flip. The nonzero-character first-subset solution for a second group, if attainable, is an affine class of size 2^(n-r). Under both actions check all 22 eligible second-site signatures for membership in the first span; replay the necessary nonzero-marginal reachability on all completed J8F controls. Report a conservative sum of at most (2^m-1)2^(n-r) terms per cell for m variable second sites (J8F count where known, inherited bound five otherwise). No sign sum or law is evaluated.
matrix.independent_unit: One deterministic private-error/selected-first-record/action rank cell; no stochastic sampling unit or interval
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin runner and all source/results before and after; require 54 unique supports, both fixed actions, J8C first-variable-site replay, action-bound second flux, 22 eligible sites, and J8F nonzero-singleton reachability. A matching rank/fingerprint is not a support equivalence.

acceptance: Complete 54-support/108-action rank matrix or report exact censored prefix at a fixed cap
Replay J8F public flux and necessary nonzero-singleton reachability on all 45 completed supports
Distinguish conservative affine-class enumeration count from a validated signed-sum algorithm or measured complete-law cost
If projected count exceeds 65,536, retain analytic signed-sum and physical action-preserving symmetry as open alternatives; do not infer impossibility or ask for a human ranking
Evaluate zero orbit expectations, complete laws, histories, arms, bootstraps or risk scores
stop_rule: Stop after all 54 supports and 108 cells or first signature-test/CPU cap; fail closed on hash, geometry, flux, J8C or J8F replay mismatch. No full-law computation is authorized by a favorable rank result.
